system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: In a near-dark showroom, <Subject:subject-1> rests on the empty floor, its carbon-fibre body held in deep shadow. The surrounding space is quiet and bare, with a broad expanse of dark floor stretching away from the vehicle and the faintest available light tracing the edges of its silhouette. The car remains still at the brink of movement, a black form almost absorbed by the darkness, while the open floor ahead reads as a flat, unbroken surface. Nothing else occupies the room; the vehicle and the shadowed space around it fill the view, and the low sheen along the body is the only separation between the car and the dark.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: The showroom is almost entirely dark; <Subject:subject-1> sits motionless on the empty floor, its carbon-fibre body barely separated from the surrounding shadow. The floor beneath and around the car is bare, and no other object breaks the dim space.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine idle hums quietly through the empty showroom, steady and subdued.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The showroom floor opens ahead as <Subject:subject-1> pulls forward, leaving the deepest shadow behind. The dark body rolls through the dim space, its carbon-fibre surfaces gathering a soft sheen as the car advances. The empty floor continues in front of it, a plain surface that catches only a trace of light, and the vehicle's movement carries it out of the dark toward clearer illumination. The car's shape becomes more distinct as it moves, with the body holding its low, smooth profile while the space around it remains bare and quiet.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The engine note rises as the tyres begin to roll, a low mechanical sound building under the car.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: <Subject:subject-1> pulls forward across the showroom floor, moving out of the dark with a steady, deliberate advance. The vehicle leaves the deepest shadow behind and rolls toward the clearer part of the dim space.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: As the car advances, its carbon-fibre body catches a soft sheen from the faint light, and the empty floor continues ahead in a broad, unbroken stretch. The shape of the vehicle becomes clearer against the shadowed showroom, while the surrounding space stays bare and quiet.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low engine idle in the empty showroom, rising to a rolling engine note as the car pulls forward.
